method: Read all nine exact current Chinese clauses and every English delta in bounded output; did not infer semantic completeness from line counts, lock hashes or link sets. Full-page source/target comparison was authored separately by internal_docs.
constraints_checked: Purpose-specific candidate eligibility and disabled/retired exclusions
Joint catalog/endpoint capabilities and min limits; unrecorded is not unlimited; image zero means no references
Overrides replace whole capability values; endpoint reset/save ordering and builtin endpoint choices
Already-submitted historical tasks preserve endpoint identity; failure never authorizes generation resubmission
Seedream generation/tier defaults, explicit resolution preservation and historical endpoint assignment
Seedance service-tier/token pricing and first-frame adaptation distinctions, Agnes audio and catalog limits, DashScope request families
Veo/Omni route/audio/input/auth boundaries, Sora catalog resolution, Kling API versions and supported inputs
Asset-reference eligibility follows endpoint identity; original credentials/account bindings and nonreference input paths preserved

contributing.accepted_change: One English clause corrected from an imperative to the Chinese source recommendation to discuss direction first, including the reason about direction mismatch closing a PR. Chinese source unchanged.

lock_boundary: Only CONTRIBUTING synced-source and providers Chinese-source fingerprints differ from original stale lock. Forward existing pipeline remains. Lock status/check/build evidence is separate; no source edition/URL/locale inversion.
limits: Source-fidelity review, not independent verification of current third-party APIs/prices. No external calls, paid generation or publication. Existing English text outside these deltas was compared by the named full-page author; this independent review does not claim fresh clause review of every unchanged English public page.
